newsitem.title: USA: CPAC Inc sees IVAX acquisition hurting Q2.
newsitem.headline: CPAC Inc sees IVAX acquisition hurting Q2.

text.p: CPAC Inc said Monday its July 22 purchase of IVAX Industries' commercial cleaning chemicals business may "negatively impact" second quarter earnings due to acquisition- related costs.
However, the company said it believes the acquisition will be accretive to earnings by the fourth quarter of fiscal 1998 and beyond.
The company said sales for the full fiscal year ending March 31, 1998 will be about $113 million, with about $25 million coming from commercial/janitorial cleaning products.
The company said acquisitions are the primary method by which it will continue to meet "double-digit" sales growth. It said it is considering candidates in both imaging and direct selling.
